criteria.given: An untrusted checkout contains a project dispatcher
criteria.when: A client invokes completion or a daily command through the global launcher
then: Completion is resolved by the installed launcher without executing any project dispatcher
Daily commands refuse delegation until the user explicitly trusts the current checkout and executable kit identity
Noninteractive use refuses delegation without recorded trust, and replacing the trusted executable identity invalidates trust
Shell startup files change only when the client opts in to completion installation

criteria.given: A fresh or existing client has an unsafe destination path, an unexpected file type, or a collision whose ownership is ambiguous
criteria.when: Install, upgrade, or sync prepares to write kit or generated files
then: The command identifies the conflicting path and stops before writing
Force cannot authorize an unsafe path or ambiguous ownership
An otherwise valid operation changes only known kit outputs and preserves trackable project settings

criteria.given: Preflight succeeded and a client has independent project settings
criteria.when: A kit copy or sync fails after writes begin
then: The operation reports failure and restores the prior kit file contents and existence without disturbing client files
Restart after interruption can finish recovery, and a retry succeeds on the recovered tree

criteria.given: A developer configures a tracker in a fresh project or migrates synthetic legacy credentials
criteria.when: Setup or migration stores settings and the tracker client loads them
then: Credentials are stored outside the repo in an owner-only file and are parsed as data
The public tracker record and diagnostics omit credential values, and URLs require HTTPS and reject embedded credentials
User-wide MCP changes require explicit opt-in
Tracked or staged legacy credentials trigger a warning and rotation instructions without printing values

criteria.given: A client selects a verified kit release or uses the bundled skills and tracker installer
criteria.when: AskIt installs, upgrades or prepares approved dependencies
then: Kit execution requires a verified match to the selected immutable revision
Bundled skill sources resolve to pinned commits and package installers use exact reviewed versions
New project skill sources require approval before fetch, and mandatory preparation failures propagate

criteria.given: A trusted project has a valid check and the caller exports synthetic credentials
criteria.when: The client runs a CheckPlan or an instrumented test
then: Routine checks run with an explicit allowlist and receive extra variables only when explicitly configured for the check
Retained outputs use private permissions and are excluded from normal Git staging
Help states that local execution retains the account's filesystem and network access and directs untrusted changes to isolated CI

criteria.given: A project supplies a valid model override or one that cannot be represented as a single model scalar
then: Valid input round-trips as one model value
Invalid input is rejected before existing outputs change

criteria.given: A developer starts the workbench with the default settings
then: The service listens only on loopback by default
Any non-loopback listener requires explicit user configuration
